description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Gasket for the Sending Unit.
Goes inside the both the fuel sending unit that measures the amount of fuel left in the tank
Fit Carbureted and EFI tanks.
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Rear Bumper Bar
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki Sidekick 1989 – 1998 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
